page_summary: Ports are central to modern economies and face increasing cyber risks. As operations evolve towards 'Port 4.0', integrating various technologies, cyber incidents can disrupt operations and safety. Strengthening cybersecurity does not require new structures but can be integrated into existing governance and operational practices. The report outlines a global cybersecurity landscape in ports, emphasizing resilience, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. It provides recommendations for establishing a cybersecurity framework and maintaining an inventory of critical assets to enhance resilience and recovery.
